offer_terms.claim_guidance: Use 'about 50% less than monthly Pro' or show $149/mo versus $75/mo billed annually. Do not call this 50% off the standard annual price.

guardrails: Do not compare arms across different audiences or bid strategies.
Keep destination, audience, placement, budget and schedule identical inside each pair.
Do not declare a winner before both arms clear the conversion floor.
Use pair 10 only while the founding offer is active.
